newsitem.title: USA: Grant Geophysical held by Calif. investor.
newsitem.headline: Grant Geophysical held by Calif. investor.

text.p: Richard McKenzie Jr., a Greenbrae, Calif., investor, said Tuesday he holds a 5.4 percent stake in Grant Geophysical Inc.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, McKenzie said he paid $2.2 million for 730,100 common shares of Grant and holds the stake for investment.
McKenzie is president of McKenzie, Walker Investment Management Inc, an investment adviser based in Greenbrae.
Grant Geophysical is a Houston-based oil industry services company.
